# 3c Upstream refresh, catalog, search: contract

**Read first:** [build README → Phase 3](./README.md#phase-3-routing), [upstream refresh](../processes/routing/upstream-refresh.md), [catalog search](../processes/routing/catalog-search.md), [domain sources](../integrations/domain-sources.md) (v2fly names and archive, iplist catalog), [jobs](../processes/platform/jobs.md) (schedules, coalescing), [notifications](../processes/platform/notifications.md), designs `RP-Service` (the rejected band), `RP-Services`, `RP-Search`, `RP-Settings`, and the **As built** of 3a, 3b and 2c (schedules, `NotificationRenderer` with plural forms, a module's settings page).

**Done when:** every upstream service in a list is refreshed daily at `routing.refresh_at` and on **Refresh now** (one service) or **Refresh all** (a list); a changed snapshot passes the empty and shrink checks to be accepted (its lists' targets marked) or is stored rejected, waiting for **Accept anyway** or **Dismiss**; failures keep the snapshot and notify at the third in a row; the daily round ends in one digest event that notifies when something happened; the catalog (v2fly lists with a reverse index from the repository archive, the three iplist portals with every domain) is refreshed daily at `routing.catalog_at` and on demand, written as a new generation per source while search keeps answering from the old one; the search page finds selectors instantly with filters, previews any of them over the network and adds them to lists; Settings → Routing shows the module's settings; every checklist line has its test.

Not in 3c: the "Discover xyz.com" suggestion when nothing matches (3g, with discovery's page); the dashboard's Routing area (3f).

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Service | `refresh.Service` (Deps: DB, Events, Settings, Jobs, `Services`, `Lists`, `Resolver`, `Marker`, `Now`, Log). `Module.Refresh`. | Build README layout. |
| One refresh | `Refresh(ctx, serviceID, inRound, actor) (Outcome, error)`: custom services are never refreshed (`services.ErrCustom`). Resolve outside any transaction (30 s per request), then one `Write`, by outcome: **failed** (any resolve error, `*sources.UnreachableError` included: "every portal unreachable" is a failure, never an empty snapshot) → `failures + 1`, `last_error`; at `failures = 3` with `failing_notified = 0` → `routing.refresh_failing{failures, error}` and `failing_notified = 1`; **same** (hash equal to the accepted one) → `last_checked_at`, `failures = 0`, `last_error = ''`, `failing_notified = 0`, and a waiting rejection ends (below); **different** → the safety checks, then accepted or rejected (below), with the same bookkeeping as same. Only `refresh_failing` and the snapshot events are events; `last_checked_at` and the failure count are bookkeeping. | upstream-refresh.md steps 2–7. |
| Safety checks | Against the accepted snapshot, by name (a name changing form isn't lost): **empty** when the new set has no name at all; **shrink** when the accepted one has at least `routing.shrink_min` names and the new one lost more than `routing.shrink_pct` percent of them (`lost × 100 > pct × old`), the percent shown rounded down ("shrink 58 %" for 120 → 50 when the 50 are old names). Snapshots under the floor are never checked for shrink. | upstream-refresh.md step 5; Build README defaults (50 %, 20). |
| Accepted | Insert the new snapshot `accepted` (`added`, `removed` against the old one, `in_round`, `accepted_at`), the old one `superseded`; `routing.snapshot_accepted{added, removed, suffix, exact, forced: false, in_round}`; `Marker.Mark(Change{Services: [id], Why: "anthropic changed upstream"})`. | step 6. |
| Rejected | Insert it `rejected` with `reason` (`empty` / `shrink`), `lost_pct`, `in_round`; `routing.snapshot_rejected{reason, old_count, new_count, lost_pct, in_round}`, which notifies by itself only when `in_round` is false. A rejection whose hash equals the newest rejected snapshot of the service (still undismissed) inserts nothing and records nothing. Targets are not marked. | step 7; one notification per new rejection. |
| Waiting | A service's **waiting** snapshot: its newest rejected snapshot, undismissed, fetched after the accepted snapshot was accepted. A refresh that comes back **same** as the accepted one ends it: `dismissed_at = now` and `routing.snapshot_dismissed{new_count, automatic: true}`. The service's state: `waiting` while one waits, else `failing` while `failures > 0`, else `ok`. | "Dismiss leaves it rejected. The next refresh checks again from the current accepted snapshot." |
| Accept anyway / Dismiss | `Accept(ctx, serviceID, snapshotID, actor)`: only the waiting snapshot (`refresh.ErrNotWaiting`); one `Write`: it becomes `accepted` with `forced_by = actor`, `accepted_at`, its `added`/`removed` recomputed against the accepted one it replaces (now `superseded`); `routing.snapshot_accepted{…, forced: true}`; marked. Strength 2: "Accept 83 names for netflix? Targets of Main and Parents lose 131 names on their next sync." `Dismiss(ctx, serviceID, snapshotID, actor)`: `dismissed_at`; `routing.snapshot_dismissed{new_count, automatic: false}`. | "Handling a rejection". |
| Jobs | `routing.refresh` (queue `refresh`, 1 attempt, resource and coalescing key `service:<id>`, step `refresh`, payload `{service_id}`): **Refresh now** and **Refresh all** (one per upstream member of the list). `routing.refresh_round` (queue `refresh`, 1 attempt, coalescing key `round`, steps `refresh`, `digest`): the schedule's job. A resolve failure is an outcome, not a job failure: the job fails only on a database error (`job.failed`). | jobs.md; architecture.md queues. |
| The round | Schedule `routing.refresh_round` (`At: "04:00"`, `Setting: "routing.refresh_at"`, jitter 5 min) enqueues the job of the same name. Step `refresh`: every upstream service in at least one list, by id, through `Refresh(id, true, job actor)`, each in its own transaction; a failing one doesn't stop the others; the failed tags are kept in the payload (`SavePayload` after each failure), so a resume after a restart (which runs the step again from the first service: unchanged ones are **same** and record nothing) still knows them. Step `digest`: `changed`, `added`, `removed`, `rejected` from this job's own events (actor `job:<id>`: `snapshot_accepted`, `snapshot_rejected`); from the payload's failed tags, `failing` = those that **started** failing in this round (their failure count is now 1) and `still_failing` = the others; then `routing.refresh_digest{changed, added, removed, rejected, failing, still_failing, services}` (subject `routing:refresh`), notifying when `changed + rejected + failing > 0` (the user's choice: a service failing for days is news on its first day only; the text still counts it). | upstream-refresh.md steps 1 and 8. |
| Catalog job | `routing.catalog_refresh` (queue `refresh`, 1 attempt, coalescing key `catalog`, steps `v2fly`, `iplist`, `finish`); schedule `routing.catalog_refresh` (`At: "04:30"`, `Setting: "routing.catalog_at"`, jitter 5 min), named like its job; **Refresh catalog** on the search page enqueues it now. A source that fails records its failure and keeps its generation; the step still **succeeds**, so the other source refreshes. | catalog-search.md step 4. |
| v2fly catalog | One API request, `GET <GitHubAPI>repos/v2fly/domain-list-community/commits/master` with `Accept: application/vnd.github.sha` (and `Authorization: Bearer <routing.github_token>` when set), gives the commit; when it equals the stored `revision`, nothing is downloaded (`refreshed_at` moves). Otherwise `GET <Codeload>v2fly/domain-list-community/tar.gz/<commit>` (≤ 32 MiB; `master` when the API failed, revision `""`): every file under `<top>/data/` is a list `v2fly:<name>`, parsed with `sources.ParseList` and resolved in memory with includes and their filters (3a's rules, no network). Rows: one `list` entry per file with its resolved name count; one `routing_catalog_domains` row per **direct** entry (list, name, exact, attributes); one `routing_catalog_includes` row per include with its filter. The trees API is not used: the archive already names every list. | Build README defaults; the archive is ~340 KB, 1 542 lists, ~39 000 direct entries (2026-10-08). |
| iplist catalog | Per portal: `GET <base>?format=custom&data=domains&wildcard=1&template={group}\|{site}\|{data}` (≤ 16 MiB), lines `group\|site\|domain` (split on the first two `\|`; malformed lines and invalid domains skipped). Rows: a `group` entry per group (its sites and names), a `site` entry per site (its group and names), a domain row per (site, domain) as suffix. When the body's SHA-256 equals the stored `revision`, nothing is rewritten. | Verified live on 2026-10-08 (`{data}` prints each domain); main ~880 lines, beta ~4 500, russia ~350. |
| Generations | A source writes generation `current + 1`: rows in batches of 5 000 per `Write`, then one short `Write` flips `routing_catalog_sources` (`generation`, `refreshed_at`, `revision`, `entries`, `failures = 0`, `last_error = ''`, `failing_since = NULL`, `notified = 0`), then the old generation's rows are deleted in batches. Readers always join on the source's current generation, so a search during a refresh sees the old catalog until the flip. Rows of any other generation (a refresh cut short) are deleted by the next refresh and by the prune job. | No long write transaction (the one write connection is shared). |
| Source failures | A failed source: `failures + 1`, `failing_since` (when NULL), `last_error`. Step `finish`: `routing.catalog_refreshed{v2fly, iplist_main, iplist_beta, iplist_russia}` (entries; `-1` for a failed source) when at least one source wrote a generation or failed; then, for each source with `failures ≥ 3` and `notified = 0`, `routing.catalog_refresh_failed{source, error, since}` and `notified = 1`. Three failures in a row means three days with the daily schedule. | catalog-search.md step 4; events.md "on after 3 days". |
| Search | `catalog.Search(ctx, Query{Q, Source, Kind, Portal, Limit})`: case-insensitive substring of the entry's name over the current generations; v2fly lists first, then iplist groups, then sites, each by name; at most 200 (then "N more: type more of the name"). Each result: the selector as it would be written (below), kind, portal, the group of a site or the sites of a group, the domain count, the service holding **exactly this selector** with its lists (else "not a service"), and the source's age when over 36 h ("catalog 3 days old"). An empty query shows no rows. | catalog-search.md steps 1–2. |
| Spelling | v2fly: `v2fly:<name>`. iplist, for a row of portal *P* with name *N*: `iplist:N` when no portal before *P* has *N* as a site or a group, else `iplist:P:N` ("beta, added pinned"). A **group** whose portal also has a **site** *N* can't be selected (the site wins there): the row says so and has no **Add**. | catalog-search.md rule "iplist selectors are added the way they will resolve". |
| Preview | `GET /routing/search/preview?selector=…` (htmx drawer): resolves now (the interactive deadline): "fetched just now · not a service yet" (or its service), suffix / exact / skipped counts, the first 200 names (suffix or exact), then "… N more", and each skipped line with its reason ("regexp: lines aren't supported on RouterOS, e.g. regexp:^.*\.apple\.com\.cn$"). Errors in the drawer ("v2fly has no list 'x'"). | catalog-search.md step 3. |
| Add from search | **Add to lists…** → `/routing/services/add?selector=<sel>` (3b's page with the lists, the default ticked); a result already a service → **Add to Parents…** when lists remain (`/routing/services/:id/lists`), else **Open service**. | catalog-search.md edge cases. |
| Rejected band | The service page shows the waiting snapshot first (`RP-Service`): "Today's snapshot was held back" (or the day it came), "It has 83 domains instead of 212: a 61 % drop, above the 50 % safety limit." (empty: "It came back empty."), **Removed · N** and **Added · N** (the first 20 names each, "… N more" linking the diff), **Keep 212, dismiss this one**, **Accept anyway…**, and "Routers keep the 212 domains until you decide." | upstream-refresh.md "Handling a rejection". |
| Likely cause | The user chose this design extra. On the rejected band and on a snapshot's diff page, for a v2fly or iplist service: `catalog.WhereAre(ctx, removed names, the service's own selector)` looks the removed names up in the current catalog (v2fly lists that hold them directly, iplist sites); when one selector holds at least half of them: "Likely cause: 128 of the 131 removed names are now in v2fly:netflix-cdn (catalog of 8 Oct)." with **Add v2fly:netflix-cdn…** (the add page, the service's lists ticked). No holder that big, a URL service or an empty catalog: no line. Computed when the page renders, never stored. | `RP-Service`'s "Likely cause". |
| Refresh now | Upstream service page: **Refresh now** (primary, key `r`) → `routing.refresh` → back to the page with a band "Refresh queued · job #123" while the job is queued or running; the Source area polls every 2 s until it ends (`hx-trigger="every 2s"`, as 2d's cut-off area). The Source area shows "Last check today 04:00 · fetched ok" or "failing since 4 Oct · 3 failures · HTTP 404", and the last accepted snapshot. **Refresh all** on a list page enqueues one per upstream member: "Refreshing 22 services". | ui/README service page. |
| Lists and services pages | Services list: the **State** column and filter (ok, waiting, failing), the status line "28 services · refreshed daily at 04:00 · 1 snapshot waiting · 1 failing", key `r` on a row refreshes it. List page: each member's state; warnings gain "Rejected snapshot · v2fly:netflix: today's refresh lost 61 % of its domains (212 → 83). Targets keep the old 212 until you decide." (link **Review**) and "Refresh failing · tunneled-domains: 3 days, HTTP 404". | `RP-Services`, `RP-List`. |
| Settings page | `SettingsPageDeclarer`: **Settings → Routing** (`/settings/routing`, order 38) through the platform's settings form, in three groups: Upstream refresh (`refresh_at`, `shrink_min`, `shrink_pct`), Catalog (`catalog_at`, `github_token`), Routers (`sync_delay`, `drift_every`, `drift_repair`, with the note "Used from router sync on"). Field labels and help: `settings.field.routing.<name>` (+ `.help`). | 2c's pattern. |
| Notifications | `NotificationRenderer` for the module's texts (EN/RU, plural forms): `routing.snapshot_rejected` 🟡 "{subject}: new snapshot held back" / "It has {new} domains instead of {old} ({reason}). Targets keep the old list until you decide."; `routing.refresh_failing` 🔴 "{subject}: refresh failing" / "{failures} failures in a row: {error}. Targets keep the last good list."; `routing.refresh_digest` 📋 "Routing refresh: {changed} services changed (+{added} / −{removed} domains)" or, with nothing changed, "Routing refresh: no changes" / "{rejected} held back · {failing} started failing · {still_failing} still failing" (each part only when not zero); `routing.catalog_refresh_failed` 🔴 "Catalog: {source} failing since {date}" / "{error}. Search shows its catalog of {date}." Buttons open the service, `/routing/services` or `/routing/search`. | events.md; notifications.md. |
| Prune | Job `routing.prune` (queue `maintenance`, step `prune`), schedule `routing.prune` (`At: "05:10"`): superseded snapshots fetched more than 90 days ago; rejected ones dismissed or no longer waiting and fetched more than 90 days ago; catalog rows of any generation that isn't current. Later sub-phases add their own lines (3d, 3e, 3g). Deletes in batches; records nothing. | data-model.md#retention. |

## Go signatures

### `routing/refresh`

```go
var ErrNotWaiting = errors.New("refresh: the snapshot isn't waiting for a decision")

type Outcome struct {
	ServiceID      int64
	Tag            string
	Result         string // same, accepted, rejected, failed
	Added, Removed int
	Err            error // failed: the resolve error
}
type Deps struct {
	DB       *db.DB
	Events   *events.Catalog
	Settings *settings.Store
	Jobs     *jobs.System
	Services *services.Service
	Lists    *lists.Service
	Resolver *sources.Resolver
	Marker   change.Marker
	Now      func() time.Time
	Log      *slog.Logger
}
type Service struct{ /* … */ }
func New(d Deps) *Service

func (s *Service) Refresh(ctx context.Context, serviceID int64, inRound bool, actor string) (Outcome, error)
func (s *Service) Accept(ctx context.Context, serviceID, snapshotID int64, actor string) error // ErrNotWaiting
func (s *Service) Dismiss(ctx context.Context, serviceID, snapshotID int64, actor string) error // ErrNotWaiting
func (s *Service) RefreshNow(ctx context.Context, serviceID int64, actor string) (jobID int64, err error)
func (s *Service) RefreshList(ctx context.Context, listID int64, actor string) (queued int, err error)
func (s *Service) Waiting(ctx context.Context, serviceID int64) (services.Snapshot, bool, error)
func (s *Service) State(ctx context.Context, serviceID int64) (string, error) // ok, waiting, failing
func (s *Service) LastDigest(ctx context.Context) (events.Event, bool, error)  // the dashboard (3f)
func (s *Service) JobTypes() []jobs.Type       // routing.refresh, routing.refresh_round
func (s *Service) Schedules() []jobs.Schedule // routing.refresh_round
// Check is the safety check, pure: "" when the new set may be accepted.
func Check(old, new snapshot.Set, minNames, maxLostPct int) (reason string, lostPct int)
```

### `routing/catalog`

```go
type Entry struct {
	Source  string // v2fly, iplist:main, iplist:beta, iplist:russia
	Kind    string // list, site, group
	Name    string
	Group   string // a site's group
	Sites   int    // a group's sites
	Domains int
}
type Result struct {
	Entry
	Selector   string // as it would be written
	Portal     string // iplist
	Selectable bool
	Service    *services.Item // holding exactly this selector
	Lists      []string
	Age        time.Duration // of its source's catalog
}
type Query struct {
	Q, Source, Kind, Portal string
	Limit                   int
}
type SourceStatus struct {
	Source       string
	RefreshedAt  time.Time // zero: never
	Entries      int
	Failures     int
	FailingSince time.Time
	LastError    string
}
type Deps struct {
	DB       *db.DB
	Events   *events.Catalog
	Settings *settings.Store
	Jobs     *jobs.System
	Services *services.Service
	Lists    *lists.Service
	Fetch    *sources.Fetcher
	Endpoints sources.Endpoints
	Now      func() time.Time
	Log      *slog.Logger
}
type Service struct{ /* … */ }
func New(d Deps) *Service

func (s *Service) Search(ctx context.Context, q Query) (results []Result, more int, err error)
func (s *Service) Status(ctx context.Context) ([]SourceStatus, error)
func (s *Service) RefreshNow(ctx context.Context, actor string) (jobID int64, err error)
func (s *Service) JobTypes() []jobs.Type       // routing.catalog_refresh
func (s *Service) Schedules() []jobs.Schedule // routing.catalog_refresh
// WhereAre finds the catalog selectors (other than except) holding the names
// directly, the biggest holder first.
type Holder struct {
	Selector string
	Names    int // how many of the names it holds
}
func (s *Service) WhereAre(ctx context.Context, names []string, except string) ([]Holder, time.Time /* the catalog's age */, error)
// Spell is the iplist spelling rule, pure: portals in order, each with its sites and groups.
func Spell(portal, name string, has func(portal, name string) bool) (selector string)
```

### `routing/sources/sourcestest` additions

```go
func (u *Upstream) Commit(sha string)                 // the GitHub commits API answer; "" answers 500
func (u *Upstream) GitHubDown(down bool)              // the API and codeload answer 502
func (u *Upstream) ExportDown(portal string, down bool) // only the portal's custom export fails
// Codeload serves a tar.gz of every V2fly() file under domain-list-community-<sha>/data/.
// The custom export is built from every Site().
```

### `routing/routingtest` additions

```go
func (h *Harness) StartJobs()             // job workers on the harness clock
func (h *Harness) Drain()                 // until no job is queued or running
func (h *Harness) RunSchedule(name string) // enqueue that schedule's job now
```

## Routes

| Method, path | What |
|---|---|
| `POST /routing/services/:id/refresh` | Refresh now → the service page |
| `POST /routing/services/:id/snapshots/:snap/accept` | Accept anyway (strength 2) |
| `POST /routing/services/:id/snapshots/:snap/dismiss` | Dismiss |
| `GET /routing/services/:id/source` | The Source area (htmx poll while a refresh runs) |
| `POST /routing/lists/:id/refresh` | Refresh all |
| `GET /routing/search` | Search (`q`, `source`, `kind`, `portal`) |
| `GET /routing/search/preview` | Preview drawer (`selector`) |
| `POST /routing/catalog/refresh` | Refresh catalog now |
| `GET /settings/routing`, `POST /settings/routing` | Settings → Routing (the platform's settings handlers) |

## Pages

- **Search** (`RP-Search`): title "Search the catalog", status line "v2fly lists and iplist sites and groups, kept here and searched instantly · refreshed today 04:30" (a failing source adds "v2fly: failing since 6 Oct, showing the catalog of 5 Oct"; an empty catalog says "The catalog fills every day at 04:30, or now with Refresh catalog."), **Refresh catalog**. A query field (autofocus, htmx on input with a 300 ms delay), chips **All sources** / **v2fly · N** / **iplist · N**, selects **Kind** and **Portal** (all in the URL). Rows (`data-row`): selector and its line ("list · 198 domains", "group · 14 sites · main", "site · group apple · main", "· beta, added pinned", "catalog 3 days old"), kind, in lists ("Main" or "not a service" muted), **Preview** (`↵`) and **Add to lists…** (`a`). The drawer opens beside the table (below it on a phone) with `esc` to close.
- **Service page** additions: the rejected band, **Refresh now**, the Source area's check line, the state word.
- **Settings → Routing**: the platform's form with the module's three groups.

## Doc changes in the same commit

- `docs/processes/routing/upstream-refresh.md`: a refresh equal to the accepted snapshot ends a waiting rejection; a repeated identical rejection records nothing; the digest is the event `routing.refresh_digest`, recorded after every round and notifying only when something changed, was held back or is failing; failures in the digest are this round's.
- `docs/processes/routing/catalog-search.md`: v2fly names come from the archive (the API only gives the commit, and nothing is downloaded when it didn't change); iplist's export carries every domain (`{group}|{site}|{data}`); each source is written as a new generation; a group shadowed by a same-name site can't be selected; results are capped at 200.
- `docs/integrations/domain-sources.md#iplist`: the custom template's `{data}` placeholder and the reverse index were written while planning (2026-10-08); add the generations and the unchanged-export skip.
- `docs/events.md#routing`: `routing.refresh_digest`, `routing.snapshot_dismissed{automatic}`, `routing.catalog_refreshed` recorded only when a source changed or failed; the texts of the four notifying events.
- `docs/data-model.md#retention`: rejected snapshots, catalog generations.
- `docs/open-questions.md`: "to verify" 4 answered (it is already struck through in the planning commit; keep it).

## Checklist

Refresh, in `refresh/` (`routingtest` with `StartJobs` where jobs run):

- [x] v2fly adds 3 domains to `anthropic` → accepted (`added 3`), its lists marked, and the round's digest says `changed 1, added 3` — `refresh_test.go` `TestAcceptedChangeMarksAndDigests`
- [x] An unchanged list → `last_checked_at` only: no snapshot, no event, nothing in the digest — `refresh_test.go` `TestUnchangedIsBookkeeping`
- [x] A URL source returning an empty `200` → rejected `empty`, no mark, listed in the digest as held back — `refresh_test.go` `TestEmptyIsRejected`
- [x] 120 names come back as 50 → rejected "shrink 58 %"; **Accept anyway** → accepted with `forced: true` and marked; accepting a snapshot that isn't waiting → `ErrNotWaiting` — `refresh_test.go` `TestShrinkAndAcceptAnyway`
- [x] 12 names come back as 3 → accepted (under the floor) — `refresh_test.go` `TestShrinkFloor`
- [x] With `routing.shrink_pct` 30, 100 → 65 is rejected; with 40 it is accepted — `checks_test.go` `TestShrinkSettings`
- [x] `include:geolocation-cn` answering `404` → a failure, the snapshot kept, no partial snapshot — `refresh_test.go` `TestFailedIncludeKeepsSnapshot`
- [x] Every source down on three daily rounds → each round's refreshes fail and the snapshots stay; on the third, one `routing.refresh_failing` per service; a fourth failure records no second one; a success resets — `refresh_test.go` `TestThirdFailureNotifiesOnce`
- [x] `iplist:beta:apple` with beta unreachable → a failure, the snapshot kept — `refresh_test.go` `TestPinnedPortalDown`
- [x] **Refresh now** making a rejection → `snapshot_rejected{in_round: false}` notifies by itself (its `NotifyIf`); in the round it doesn't — `refresh_test.go` `TestRejectionOutsideRoundNotifies`
- [x] A service in no list isn't refreshed by the round; **Refresh now** still refreshes it — `round_test.go` `TestRoundSkipsServicesInNoList`
- [x] The same rejection twice records one event; a refresh equal to the accepted snapshot ends a waiting rejection (`snapshot_dismissed{automatic}`); **Dismiss** ends it by hand — `refresh_test.go` `TestWaitingRejection`
- [x] A round cut short after two services resumes, records no second event for them, and its digest still counts them — `round_test.go` `TestRoundResumes`
- [x] Two services of one list both accepted in a round → two marks of that list (the one coalesced router sync is 3e's test) — `round_test.go` `TestRoundMarksEachChange`
- [x] The digest notifies only when something changed, was held back or started failing; a service failing for a second day is counted in `still_failing` and doesn't make it notify — `digest_test.go` `TestDigestNotifiesOnlyWithNews`

Catalog, in `catalog/` (`sourcestest`):

- [x] Query "apple" → v2fly lists containing "apple", the iplist group `apple` and iplist sites containing "apple", each with portal and kind — `search_test.go` `TestSearchApple`
- [x] Query "apple", filter iplist → only iplist rows; kind and portal filters — `search_test.go` `TestSearchFilters`

## As built

Built 2026-10-09 in one context. Every checklist line has its test of that name in that file; `make check`, `make lint` and `docker build .` are green. Every package of the module still runs under `-race`.

**Packages** as in Files, except: the refresh and catalog texts live in `routing/messages_refresh.go` (merged by `init`, like 3b's), `pages/refresh.go` holds the service page's refresh handlers, and the store's state query is `store/refresh.go`. `TestPruneSnapshotsAndGenerations` and `TestRefreshNotificationTexts` are in the module root (`prune_test.go`, `notify_test.go`). CSS for the new parts (`.band.rejected`, `.rej-cols`, `.rej-acts`, `.cause`, `.search-form`, `.search-cols`, `.preview`, `.row.cat`, `.set-group`, `.row.svc .state`) is in the platform's `app.css`.

**Deviations and additions** (the contract's signatures otherwise hold):

- **The round's resume skips what is done.** Its payload is `{done: [service ids], failed: {tag: started}, services}`, saved after every service, so a resume after a restart goes on after the last finished service instead of running the step again from the first one: a failed service is then not counted twice (its failure count would otherwise reach 2 and move it from `failing` to `still_failing`). A refresh cut short by the shutdown (the context ends) records nothing.
- **Waiting is by id**: the newest rejected snapshot with an id above the accepted one, when it is undismissed (a dismissed newest one means nothing waits, even if an older rejection is undismissed). The "same rejection again" check compares with the **waiting** snapshot, not the newest undismissed one, so a rejection that stopped waiting (a Switch or a forced accept since) is recorded again.
- **An unpinned iplist selector is refreshed on the portal of its accepted snapshot** (main when there is none): a miss there is a failure, never a silent switch to another portal (the Phase 3 decision on pinning, carried to refreshes).
- `sources.ErrorText(err)` (moved out of `refresh`, used by the catalog too): "HTTP 404", "include:x: HTTP 404", "beta unreachable", "v2fly has no list 'x'", "timed out". `sources.Fetcher.Token` is gone; `Fetcher.GetWith(ctx, url, max, header)` carries GitHub's `Accept` and `Authorization`. `sources.Local` resolves parsed lists in memory (includes with filters, cycles ignored), `sources.Count`, `Include.Filter()`.
- `refresh` additions: `States(ctx)` (all services, for lists), `ActiveJob(ctx, serviceID)` (the queued or running refresh, through `jobs.System.Holding`), `Digest`, `JobRefresh`/`JobRound`, `RoundSubject`, `Same/Accepted/Rejected/Failed`, `ReasonEmpty/ReasonShrink`, `FailingAfter`. `Accept` marks with `Why` "<tag> accepted anyway".
- `catalog` additions: `Matches(ctx, q)` (the chips' counts per source family), `Counts`, `ActiveJob`, `Prune(ctx)`, `Sources`, `Subject`, `JobRefresh`, `FailingAfter`, `MaxResults`. A source whose answer is unchanged (v2fly commit, iplist SHA-256) moves `refreshed_at` and ends its failures but writes nothing and doesn't count as "changed" for `catalog_refreshed`. `WhereAre` returns the catalog date of the top holder's source. A list whose include is missing from the archive counts its direct names.
- **The prune job and a running catalog refresh**: the prune job deletes generations older than the one in force always, newer ones (cut short) only while no catalog refresh is queued or running (one may be writing them); a refresh deletes every other generation before writing its own.
- `store`: `States`, `Waiting`, `UpstreamInLists`, `UpstreamMembers`, `RefreshFailed/Answered`, `AcceptRejected`, the catalog statements (`CatalogSearch`, `IplistNamed`, `CatalogHolders`, `DeleteStaleCatalog(…, olderOnly, …)`, inserts chunked at 1 000 rows per statement inside 5 000-row transactions), `PruneSnapshots`, `SnapshotRetention`, `PruneBatch`, `StateOK/Waiting/Failing`, `ServiceBySelector`.
- `services`: `Preview(ctx, raw)` (Prepare without the tag check; a selector with no usable name returns what it resolved with its `*EmptyResolveError`, so the drawer shows the skipped lines), `BySelector`, `FromRow`; `Row.State` and `Filter.State` work.
- Platform: `ui.SettingsGroups` + `ui.SettingsGroup` (the settings form in titled groups); a secret field that is set shows "set · leave empty to keep" and a **Clear it** box (`clear.<key>`); the routing handler keeps the token on an empty field and clears it on the box. `proxier.js`: `esc` clicks a visible `[data-esc]` (the preview drawer's ×). Messages `ui.clear_secret`, `ui.secret_kept`.
- Pages: the services list's rows are `div`s now (the tag is the link) so each upstream row carries its **↻** form (`data-key="r" data-row-only`); a row refresh redirects to `/routing/services?refreshed=<tag>` with a band. The Source area polls `…/source?polling=1` every 2 s while a refresh is queued or running; the answer after it ended sets `HX-Refresh: true`, so the page reloads with the new state, band and history. Accept/Dismiss of a snapshot that no longer waits redirect with `?gone=1` (a band), not an error. The Dismiss button is labelled "Keep 212, dismiss this one" (the contract's words). Search: the query form swaps `#search-results` with `hx-select` (the full page answers), Enter on a row opens the preview as a page (`?selector=`), **Preview** swaps the drawer `#preview`; the "Add to lists…" link of the likely cause ticks the service's lists through `?lists=` on the add page. The list warnings say "Refresh failing · tunneled-domains: 3 failures in a row, HTTP 404" (services keep no "failing since"). The status line keeps 3a's custom count: "28 services · 2 custom · refreshed daily at 04:00 · 1 snapshot waiting · 1 failing".
- `routingtest`: `StopJobs` (a shutdown: running jobs become interrupted), `Job(id)`; the module clock is read under a mutex (jobs read it from their goroutines). `sourcestest`: `Hang(path, on)`, `Auth()`, `Fail(path, 0)` undoes a failure, `DefaultCommit`.

**Facts later sub-phases rely on.**

- `refresh.Service.LastDigest` is the dashboard's (3f) source; `routing.refresh_digest`'s payload has `services` as a count.
- An accepted snapshot marks `change.Change{Services: [id], Why: "<tag> changed upstream", Actor: job:<id>}`; a round marks once per changed service (3e coalesces).
- `catalog.Service.WhereAre(names, except)` is discovery's (3g) reverse lookup: direct holders only (v2fly lists, iplist sites), spelled as they would be added. `catalog.Spell` is the iplist spelling rule.
- The search page has no Discover suggestion yet (3g); its empty-result line is `catalog.no_match`.
- The routing prune job (`routing.prune`, 05:10, queue `maintenance`) is where 3d (Shadowrocket fetches), 3e (syncs) and 3g (discovery runs) add their lines: `Module.Prune`.

**Not done / the user's.** No real v2fly archive, GitHub API or iplist export was fetched (all `sourcestest`); the real archive's top directory and sizes are as observed while planning. A real-browser look at the rejected band, the Source area's poll and reload, the search page's live query and drawer (`esc`), the row `r` key and the settings groups is the user's: headless Chrome was not tried this session (it failed to start in the last two), so these were exercised only through the HTTP tests. No Telegram delivery of the new texts.
